tools.name: search
tools.description: Find passages, hadith and works of Bayān's library. Each passage or hadith comes with its ref, its citation and its public url.

tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: Read a passage by its ref: the Arabic text, its stored translation when there is one, its citation, the edition's attribution and neighbouring passages.

tools.name: get_verse
tools.description: Read one verse of the Quran or a run of verses: the Arabic text, the translation with its credit, and refs to the tafsir passages linked to them.

tools.name: lookup_work
tools.description: Find works of the library by title, author or slug; a slug restricts a search to its work.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_passage" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
